desc: Ideation: binary search on answer; feasibility as minimum walk covering visit demands; independent-set/MWIS reduction candidate.
Implement Solution.maxScore with binary search and O(n) feasibility check using prefix/suffix MWIS over a_i=c_i-1 and b_i residual weights.
Build a brute-force BFS validator for tiny arrays and move budgets.
Run sample tests and random small-case brute-force validation using `_brute_feasible`; no mismatches found.
Finalize edge-case handling (x=0, m<n, n=2, large bounds) after validation.
